query:
insert into
                users (
                    id,
                    login,
                    display_name,
                    email,
                    email_verified,
                    password_hash,
                    totp_secret,
                    totp_recovery_secret,
                    totp_recovery_codes,
                    updated_at,
                    created_at
                )
            values ($1, LOWER($2), $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, now(), now())
